correctness.rationale: The signed-filter and antichain definitions give the two cube-hull bodies exactly. For enriched order, sections at upper minimum y give an m-cube of radius T=(1+min y)/2 and T~Beta(m+1,n) after weighting by the section volume. Conditional upper coordinate minima and uniforms give the rank-one added covariance bJ_n; lower block has a_m I_m and cross covariance zero by signed symmetry. For enriched chain, cubical free-sum shell radii (R,S,1−R−S) are Dirichlet(m,n,1), giving matching diagonal a_m I_m,a_n I_n. The determinant lemma gives ratio 1+nb/a_n. Independent exact rational spot checks m,n=(1,1),(1,2),(2,1),(2,3),(7,5) matched ratios 4/3,11/8,3/2,8/5,28/13; sharp sup follows from m=t²,n=t. Source triangulation script was inspected, not treated as a universal proof.
